heldPr460.body:
Part of #458; preserves the separate owner acceptance on #276 and #325.

The launcher could abort a valid ownership check at 15 seconds despite a configured 60-second startup allowance, and it could deadlock by waiting for helper exit before draining redirected output. A native baseline reproduction fails on four valid slow ownership probes; the candidate completes the precheck and starts the matching disposable gateway.

Drain both streams in bounded chunks, retain at most 256 KiB of UTF-8 protocol stdout, and require exit zero plus complete valid output. Initial helper allowance is `max(15, StartupTimeoutSeconds)`; ownership retries share the remaining monotonic release budget. Initial failures identify the helper stage, timing, output sizes and exit status without logging raw output. An inconclusive recheck retains the last verified held owner and complete safety guidance. Slow successful checks leave metadata. API, ownership decisions, stored formats and configuration remain unchanged.

Validation at `b6ed79eeb289b781c48d3b0f994c1b2577990df9`: 27/27 native checks; independent focused QA and mutation checks; tooling lint and repository formatting passed. The preceding implementation also passed actual built-API slow ownership/startup/both-shells/managed-drain QA and all CI jobs. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43546076967) is fully green: Gates (including all coverage thresholds, licenses, generated docs and dependency audit), Browser, Windows launcher and Template image. Unchanged local Windows symlink/POSIX/SQLite test limitations are recorded in the [evidence directory](docs/qa/2026-11-13-launcher-timeouts/README.md); the complete Linux gate passed.

Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh completed diagnosis/design review, one full implementation review and one [targeted correction review](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/460#issuecomment-6870208840). Both full-review findings are fixed and mutation-verified; the targeted verdict is READY with no introduced blocker. Existing helper-descendant cleanup remains follow-up #459. The exact historical stalled helper is unrecorded; reproduced defects are not claimed as proof of the original incident.

Local repair and owner cold-launch QA: the reviewed executable is installed; configuration and all three shortcut hashes are preserved. At the owner's request, two separate normal drains confirmed process exit, closed port and released locks before the owner launched first the desktop shortcut, then the taskbar icon. Both cold launches succeeded, produced new gateway PIDs and returned 200 for health and both app shells. The final gateway is left running. Automated installed-launch execution was policy-blocked; no workaround was attempted, and the owner performed both actual clicks. No migration or reset occurred. Implementation, reviews, independent QA, CI and local cold-launch acceptance are complete. Merge awaits explicit owner authorization.

prReadback.body:
Closes #435. Owner acceptance for #276/#325 remains separate.

The Windows launcher refused a valid checkout reached through a directory junction or symbolic link because its identity helper compared two different path spellings and exited without output. The helper now compares the physical entry files, so either spelling emits the same identity and starts or reuses the matching gateway. Inert imports, configuration/runtime refusals, store checks and fingerprint contents stay intact.

The permanent Windows acceptance suite independently creates and verifies a real junction and directory symbolic link, then exercises helper output, native cold starts in both directions, same/cross-path warm reuse, wrong-store/settings refusals, exact process ownership and managed cleanup. Its test-only baseline commit `08e60a0ae6d6b7cae853326825365760166f3ad3` reproduced helper silence and native cold refusal through both genuine link types in [Windows CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43787801176/job/133039259616); the unchanged original cases passed. The same native test bytes are included with the fix.

Validation before publication: 13/13 focused API tests, API types and scoped lint/format passed. The exact final built-helper regression failed its three intended assertions on old source and passed 2/2 on the candidate. Independent GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh native QA verified the built gateway through direct and junction paths, both cold starts, warm reuse and mismatch refusals, real TCP/file SQLite, both shell assets, two authenticated drains and independent process/port/store cleanup. Local directory-symlink creation returned EPERM before product execution; the hosted fixed-source Windows result below closes that local verification gap. The initial baseline diagnostic failure and exact-identity recovery, original lint failure and offline inspector corrections are retained.

Evidence: [baseline](docs/qa/2026-11-16-launcher-identity-baseline/README.md), [implementation](docs/qa/2026-11-16-launcher-identity-implementation/README.md), and [candidate native QA plus hosted old-source reproduction](docs/qa/2026-11-16-launcher-identity-candidate/README.md). This publication also archives the already merged #419 final CI/reviews/completion, without changing that implementation.

[Publication-head CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43790735875) passed all four jobs on attempt 1 without retry: 9,619 tests / 41 skips and all 13 coverage floors; Browser 481 passes / one declared LIVE skip with zero retries; Windows 17/17 including both genuine link types; and all four distributed templates. The fixed-source hosted native run verified four cold starts, eight warm reuses, eight mismatch refusals and four managed drains. Optional strict routing performance was off; recorded frame p95 samples were 33.3–33.4 ms, so no strict-performance pass is claimed. The audit threshold passed with 8 low / 13 moderate advisories, and Windows uploaded no native artifact.

Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh formal scan 1 returned READY with no introduced blocker. Root dispositions and the full report are in the PR conversation; nonblocking follow-ups #493–#496 are parked. Fresh Astra max exact-head/target sign-off remains required before merge; one of three formal scans is complete. Source candidate is `c75e277695dae260f0e14279cff8705bab84ef4c`, based on `9fa8b2474c7290adb800c5e26be73511095cae25`. The separate PR #460 owner merge hold and owner instance/store remain untouched. This PR does not install the batch or complete broader intent acceptance.
